policy: Traceable peer-reviewed studies and explicitly identified curated secondary taxonomy records; unchanged source facts and no specialist approval

items.label: Karst forest
items.statement: Primary and secondary forest on limestone outcrops of South Gigante Island.
items.source: Brown & Alcala (1970), original Platymantis insulatus description; AMNH curated taxon record
items.journal: Occasional Papers of the California Academy of Sciences
items.sourceLocation: AMNH taxon synopsis, type and distribution
items.scopeLimit: Published South Gigante limestone forest habitat; the checklist cannot establish other-island occurrence.

items.label: Published type island
items.statement: Recorded on South Gigante Island, Iloilo, Philippines.
items.source: Brown & Alcala (1970), original Platymantis insulatus description; AMNH curated taxon record
items.journal: Occasional Papers of the California Academy of Sciences
items.sourceLocation: AMNH taxon synopsis, type and distribution
items.scopeLimit: Published South Gigante limestone forest habitat; the checklist cannot establish other-island occurrence.

items.label: Montane type locality
items.statement: The holotype came from montane forest on Mt. Banahao at about 1,400 m.
items.source: Alcala, Brown & Diesmos (1998), original P. naomii; AMNH taxon account
items.journal: Proceedings of the California Academy of Sciences
items.scopeLimit: Holotype locality is a single recorded elevation, not a full species elevational limit.

items.label: Banahao and San Cristobal
items.statement: Published records are from Mt. Banahao and Mt. San Cristobal on Luzon.
items.source: Alcala, Brown & Diesmos (1998), original P. naomii; AMNH taxon account
items.journal: Proceedings of the California Academy of Sciences
items.scopeLimit: Holotype locality is a single recorded elevation, not a full species elevational limit.

items.label: Limestone cave habitat
items.statement: The original type locality is a limestone cave in southern Negros.
items.source: Brown & Alcala (1982), original P. spelaeus; AMNH taxon account
items.journal: Proceedings of the Biological Society of Washington
items.scopeLimit: The source places the cave frog on southern Negros karst, 20–400 m, not a universal microhabitat model.

items.label: Separated from V. marmoratus
items.statement: Koch and colleagues described Palawan-region water monitors as V. palawanensis in their 2010 revision of the V. salvator complex.
items.sourceLocation: Abstract: Philippine Varanus salvator complex revision
items.scopeLimit: Distinction is based on specimen comparisons and multivariate analyses, not color alone.

items.label: Five-digit limbs
items.statement: The published diagnosis lists five digits on each limb and 27–30 midbody scale rows.
items.source: Siler et al. taxonomic revision of the Brachymeles gracilis complex; diagnosis excerpted by The Reptile Database
items.sourceLocation: Reptile Database diagnosis quoting Siler et al.; secondary transcription
items.scopeLimit: Scale counts need physical examination; database reproduction is not the original study full text.

items.label: Documented body size
items.statement: The reproduced diagnostic comparison gives a snout–vent length of 59.9–81.5 mm.
items.source: Siler et al. taxonomic revision of the Brachymeles gracilis complex; diagnosis excerpted by The Reptile Database
items.sourceLocation: Reptile Database diagnosis quoting Siler et al.; secondary transcription
items.scopeLimit: Scale counts need physical examination; database reproduction is not the original study full text.

items.label: Luban Island colony reassessed
items.statement: A 2025 Luban Island study reassessed an earlier golden-crowned flying fox identification as Pteropus spp.
items.scopeLimit: Study notes earlier Acerodon jubatus assignment, revised to possible Pteropus spp.; no definitive taxon identity claimed.

items.label: Current wild island range
items.statement: The 2025 genome paper describes remaining wild populations on Panay and Negros.
items.scopeLimit: Present distribution description cites previous surveys; genome study did not census wild deer.

items.label: 2026 genomic sample
items.statement: A 2026 study compared genomic variation in 20 wild-captive and 15 captive-bred Philippine Eagles.
items.source: Pascual et al. (2026), Scientific Reports, 17 October 2026
items.scopeLimit: Twenty wild-captive and fifteen captive-bred eagles in conservation care, not a wild population census.

items.label: Population genetic structure
items.statement: The study found higher genomic inbreeding among wild-captive than captive-bred birds in its sample.
items.source: Pascual et al. (2026), Scientific Reports, 17 October 2026
items.scopeLimit: Twenty wild-captive and fifteen captive-bred eagles in conservation care, not a wild population census.

items.label: Rasa Island vegetation
items.statement: The published Rasa study describes old-growth mangrove and coastal forest as nesting and feeding habitat.
items.source: Widdman, Lacerna & Diaz, Silliman Journal 42(2), 2001 issue (online posted 2022)
items.sourceLocation: Publisher abstract, Rasa Island 2000 nesting results
items.scopeLimit: Density estimates describe Rasa Island in 2000, not a current Philippine population estimate.

items.label: Historical Rasa breeding density
items.statement: The 2000 Rasa Island survey estimated 1.6 breeding pairs per square kilometre.
items.source: Widdman, Lacerna & Diaz, Silliman Journal 42(2), 2001 issue (online posted 2022)
items.sourceLocation: Publisher abstract, Rasa Island 2000 nesting results
items.scopeLimit: Density estimates describe Rasa Island in 2000, not a current Philippine population estimate.
